{{Quote|Don't worry, Threepio. Artoo won't get lost. He has the electrocompass.|4B-X to C-3PO|<ref name="science">''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Journey Across Planet X]]''</ref>}}
An '''electrocompass''' was a navigational instrument that helped its owner find [[Gender/Legends|his]] or her bearings on unfamiliar ground. The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] once used one such device while exploring a [[Water/Legends|snowy]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Da'nor]].<ref name="science" />
